svg.title: Core System Graph: Entity Relationships Across the Four-Tier Banking Hierarchy
svg.desc: ER diagram showing WORLD_BANK, NATIONAL_BANK, LOCAL_BANK, and BANK_USER entities connected in a 1-to-many hierarchy.
svg.text: Core System Graph: Entity Relationships Across the Four-Tier Banking Hierarchy
• The model enforces a strict four-tier hierarchy.
• Each child entity must belong to exactly one
• Deletion of a parent is restricted if dependent
• UQ = business key uniqueness within scope.
